acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Fungalfolk family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Mycelial Sovereign, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Courtyard-Network Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Courtyard-wide cap, drifting spore aurora, throne of interlocked mushrooms, and luminous mycelium across the ground.

Signature mechanic: Arena Production — Four Fruiting Nodes: the courtyard-wide cap lights one ground-mycelium route from the interlocked mushroom throne, producing the announced lower form; solving its lesson exposes that node beneath the drifting spore aurora.
battlefieldDuty: Command a throne-linked ground network that produces lower-form fruiting bodies at four readable nodes.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1 has no glow, no constant spore cloud, no smaller mushrooms, no throne, and no ground network; T2 alone adds faint gill glow; T3 adds its constant spore cloud; T4 adds smaller mushrooms; T5 adds throne and ground network.
Capillary mycelium, wet reflective cap tissue, pressurized gill valves, coherent droplets, mist release, and visible drainage distinguish Water affinity from a native damp habitat.
counterplay: Resolve the announced lower-form rule, then sever the exposed mycelial node; every cut collapses one throne section and prevents that production pattern. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1 has no glow, no constant spore cloud, no smaller mushrooms, no throne, and no ground network, so pressure loss exposes its stalk; T2 faint gill glow dims at a valve; T3 constant spore cloud clears around intake; T4 smaller mushrooms drain through the active stem; T5 throne and ground network expose the empty node.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating damp habitat as Water affinity
identityInvariants: Cap-headed, stalk-bodied silhouette with gills, bulbous limbs, and a wider top than base remains recognizable.
Pale fungal flesh and one strong cap tone contrast with bounded cyan or green gill bioluminescence from T2 onward.
Fungal flesh, spongy cap, mycelium, damp moss, and spore dust remain organic and spatially coherent.
Cap breadth, gill light, spore density, secondary growth, and ground mycelium escalate at explicit source tiers.
telegraph: The aurora narrows over one network route, one throne mushroom opens, and the linked lower-form silhouette fruits at its endpoint.
